verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party developer docs reference an official CLI (`hs`) for local development, so an official CLI exists. The only evidence is a single line about checking its version, and it sits in CMS local-development docs, so its scope for Marketing Hub workflows is unproven. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and coverage for marketing assets (emails, campaigns), authentication/scripting guidance for automated or agent use, AI-native workflow support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can check which version of the CLI you have installed by running `hs --version`.
